check_installed_demo.py.source:
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright


root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
work = root / (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "browser-demo")
work.mkdir()
environment = dict(os.environ)
for key in ("PYTHONPATH", "PYTHONHOME", "UMAT_OTI_REPO", "UMAT_OTI_REPO_ROOT"):
    environment.pop(key, None)
environment["UMAT_OTI_WORKSPACE"] = str(work / "workspace")
app = Path(importlib.util.find_spec("umat_oti").origin).parent / "app/streamlit_app.py"
assert "site-packages" in str(app), app
with socket.socket() as listener:
    listener.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    port = listener.getsockname()[1]
report = {"app": str(app), "environment": {key: environment.get(key) for key in
          ("PYTHONPATH", "UMAT_OTI_REPO", "UMAT_OTI_WORKSPACE")}, "screenshots": []}
with (work / "server.log").open("w") as log:
    server = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "streamlit", "run", str(app),
        "--server.headless=true", "--server.address=127.0.0.1", f"--server.port={port}",
        "--browser.gatherUsageStats=false"], cwd=work, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=log)
    try:
        with sync_playwright() as playwright:
            browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            try:
                page = browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1100})
                page_errors = []
                page.on("pageerror", lambda error: page_errors.append(str(error)))
                for attempt in range(30):
                    try:
                        page.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", wait_until="domcontentloaded")
                        break
                    except Exception:
                        if server.poll() is not None or attempt == 29:
                            raise
                        page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Run the demo transformation", exact=True)
                button.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=60000)
                assert page.get_by_text("The demo contract is missing", exact=False).count() == 0
                button.click()
                page.get_by_text("compiled", exact=True).first.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=120000)
                assert not page_errors, page_errors
                assert page.locator('[data-testid="stException"]').count() == 0
                for label, width, height in (("desktop", 1440, 1100), ("mobile", 390, 844)):
                    page.set_viewport_size({"width": width, "height": height})
                    page.get_by_text("compiled", exact=True).first.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                    path = work / f"{label}.png"
                    page.screenshot(path=str(path), full_page=True)
                    report["screenshots"].append({"file": path.name,
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                        "viewport": [width, height],
                        "horizontal_overflow": page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth")})
                report["page_errors"] = page_errors
            finally:
                browser.close()
        contract = work / "workspace/demo_inputs/examples/elastic_minimal.json"
        raw = json.loads(contract.read_text())
        source = (contract.parent / raw["source"]).resolve(strict=True)
        report["contract"] = {"path": str(contract), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(contract.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        report["source"] = {"path": str(source), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        completed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "umat_oti.cli_json", "--config", str(contract),
            "--out", str(work / "cli"), "--compile"], cwd=work, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True)
        (work / "cli.log").write_text(completed.stdout + completed.stderr)
        report["cli_returncode"] = completed.returncode
        assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stdout + completed.stderr
        report["generated_files"] = [str(path.relative_to(work)) for path in sorted(work.rglob("*")) if path.is_file()]
        report["passed"] = True
    finally:
        server.terminate()
        try:
            server.wait(timeout=20)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            server.kill()
            server.wait(timeout=10)
        report["server_stopped"] = server.poll() is not None
        (work / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
